name: apprise-api
title: Apprise API
description: Apprise API is one address your apps and scripts post a message to, and it passes the message on to any of some 100 services (Discord, Telegram, ntfy, Gotify, e-mail, Matrix…). After deploying, open the page, make a configuration under a key of your choice and list your notification URLs in it; apps then post to http://Apprise-API:8000/notify/<key>. It has no sign-in of its own, so keep it off the internet or behind Authelia.

variables.name: PORT_APPRISE_API
variables.label: Web port
variables.description: Host port of the web page and the API
